rationale: The agent correctly used product tools to answer the catalog question and did not disclose or fabricate account/order data. For the order modification request, the agent followed policy by requesting identity verification (email or full name plus zip), declined to proceed without it, and provided a secure-channel alternative. No unauthorized changes were made, and no writes occurred without confirmation. While the modification itself was not completed due to the user’s refusal to verify, the agent’s handling remained fully compliant with policy and appropriately concluded the interaction.
